competing_hypotheses.label: Near-term sell-pressure risk
competing_hypotheses.evidence: Large reported Binance inflow, partial Bitwise holdings reduction and long-heavy liquidations with falling open interest.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: Binance deposits do not prove sales; Nov 9 ETF flow is only 1/4; wallet same-set balances fell over 7 and 30 days.

competing_hypotheses.label: Transfer/rebalancing and deleveraging exhaustion
competing_hypotheses.evidence: Same-wallet exchange balances declined over 7 and 30 days; large gross transfers may include reserve replenishment or internal movement; open interest has contracted.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: The reported 691M XRP Binance inflow is unusually large and could become sellable inventory; long-heavy liquidations and the partial ETF outflow remain real observations.

competing_hypotheses.label: Institutional stablecoin rails can grow without requiring XRP bridge demand
competing_hypotheses.evidence: PNC-Coinbase USDC receipt-and-conversion pilot, EBA's forthcoming direct oversight of significant USDC, and BNY's custody support for XRP and RLUSD show that custody, stablecoin settlement and XRP custody can coexist.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: BNY's XRP custody support expands institutional access, and RLUSD/USDC activity on XRPL may increase XRPL utility; neither alone measures XRP bridge conversion, inventory or market purchases.

institutional_regulatory_events.event: Ripple and BNY expanded their digital-asset custody collaboration. BNY now supports XRP and RLUSD on its Digital Asset Custody platform; the parties are exploring tokenized trade-finance use cases with C2FO.
institutional_regulatory_events.xrp_relevance: Institutional custody availability for XRP expanded. This is not evidence of BNY proprietary XRP purchases, customer balances, collateral utilization or net XRP inflows.

institutional_regulatory_events.event: PNC and Coinbase announced a limited corporate/institutional pilot. Eligible PNC clients can receive USDC through Coinbase Payment APIs; incoming USDC is converted 1:1 into USD and deposited to a designated PNC account.
institutional_regulatory_events.xrp_relevance: A competing institutional dollar-payment rail. It is not an XRP corridor and does not prove substitution in any specific corridor.

parties: New York Department of Financial Services
institutional_regulatory_events.event: EBA classified USDC as the first significant e-money token under MiCA. From November 12, the EBA assumes direct supervision of own funds, reserve assets, liquidity requirements, and recovery/redemption plans; ACPR retains governance and other specified supervisory areas. EBA and ACPR will cooperate, with an EBA-NYDFS information-sharing MoU.
institutional_regulatory_events.xrp_relevance: A material regulatory event for a competing stablecoin rail. It may affect institutional confidence and reserve/liquidity oversight for USDC; it does not create XRP demand or determine XRP collateral use.

institutional_regulatory_events.event: Circle reported $73.3B average USDC circulation and $13.9T Q3 on-chain transaction volume.
institutional_regulatory_events.xrp_relevance: Stablecoin scale and payment-rail competition context only. These figures are not XRP flows, XRP liquidity or XRP collateral.
